bagPolicy.summary: All bags are searched by security before entry; the venue does not publish a general numerical bag size limit.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Metered street parking is available on Commonwealth Avenue and nearby streets; the venue also recommends booking paid parking in advance.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The club directions do not identify a designated rideshare pickup site.

concessions.summary: The Paradise Lounge sells food and has a bar. On most concert nights it opens one hour before club doors.

accessibility.summary: The club asks guests who need accommodations to call or email in advance. It is a standing-room venue with floor and wraparound balcony.

ticketPickup.summary: Will Call is available only on show night beginning at door time. The box office operates Monday–Friday noon–6 p.m. and on weekend show nights.

gates.summary: Club doors usually open an hour before showtime, with the lounge often opening an hour earlier. Most shows are 18 and over unless the listing says otherwise.
